look_here_first: Inspect the basal rosette: deeply pinnately lobed and spinulose-toothed leaves, then the leafless scape bearing 1–3 heads with 25–53 disk florets.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: One to three rayless heads with 25–53 disk florets.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Low rosette perennial, leafless flowering scape.

lookalikes.differences: A. wrightii has taller leafy stems and unlobed toothed cauline leaves, with 8–12 florets/head.
